ruleDefinitions.name: Winrar Execution in Non-Standard Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious winrar execution in a folder which is not the default installation folder

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rar\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winrar\\\.exe$")) OR process_description = "Command\ line\ RAR") AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\UnRAR\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\WinRAR\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\WinRAR\\\\.*"))) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*"))
